maya: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
maya: Did: updated the TypeScript quickstart for the sample-app (added an ESM import example + explicit env var section). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/312 :sparkles:
maya: Blocker: rust-sdk packaging test failing on mac M1 CI — segfault during native build. Opened CI ticket (#CI-789).
maya: Today: will push a minimal repro and tag @rory and @zhen for help.

rory: Thanks — I can pick this up after standup. Heads up: I merged a small client-auth doc stub that may conflict with your quickstart; if you rebase I can help resolve.

jamal: Did a pass on the embedder README and left inline comments on PR #428. No blockers from my side.

elena: FYI console team changed the quickstart link path, updating redirect now — should be live in ~20m.

docs-bot: deploy-preview #312 finished — docs deploy preview URL: https://deploy.netlify.app/preview/312 :white_check_mark:

rory: @maya for the rust segfault: can you paste the cargo output when you run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1`? Also `cargo test --verbose` if possible.

maya: Pasted minimal log below:
```
rustc: panic at 'assertion failed', src/lib.rs:102
stack backtrace:
  0: std::panicking::begin_panic

```

maya: Also tagging @zhen to see if the M1 runner needs special x86_64 flags or Rosetta setup.

zhen: I can repro locally on my M1. Will try `cargo build --release` and then qemu-x86_64 if needed. ETA ~2h.

rory: If zhen needs time, we can land the TS quickstart fix now and feature-flag the Rust snippet behind a note that the native build is flaky on arm until CI is resolved.

maya: Sounds good. I'll split the PR: land the TS quickstart change now, follow up with a rust-fix PR and a minimal repro. Thanks :thumbsup:

jamal: Small ask — can someone add a short example of `streaming: true` usage in the quickstart? A customer pinged about streaming patterns. Happy to draft the snippet.

elena: Please do, jamal. Add it as a minimal code block and I'll wire it into the quickstart page once it's in the repo.

maya: Tag me on the PRs; I'll review right after the TS merge.
